note: Regulatory clauses TrialOps must satisfy. Requirements in docs/requirements.json point here through `regs`. control = technical (covered by product requirements and tests) or procedural (covered by SOP/QMS, listed for completeness). Codes for documents without stable clause numbers are semantic; `ref` says where to look.

frameworks.P11: US 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic records; electronic signatures
frameworks.FDA-ESQA: US FDA guidance — Electronic Systems, Electronic Records, and Electronic Signatures in Clinical Investigations: Q&A (Oct 2024)
frameworks.A11: EU EudraLex Vol. 4 Annex 11 — Computerised systems (2011; revision draft 2025 not adopted)
frameworks.EMA-CS: EU EMA Guideline on computerised systems and electronic data in clinical trials (EMA/INS/GCP/112288/2023)
frameworks.E6R3: ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice (principles, Annex 1, Annex 2)
frameworks.JP-ERES: JP MHLW PFSB Notification 0401022 (2005) — Electronic records and electronic signatures
frameworks.JP-CSV: JP MHLW PFSB/CND Notification 1021-11 (2010) — Computerized system management guideline

frameworks.APPI: JP Act on the Protection of Personal Information (Act 57/2003, rev. 2022)
frameworks.AIACT: EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act) as amended by the AI Omnibus (2026)
frameworks.FDA-AI: US FDA draft guidance — Considerations for the Use of AI to Support Regulatory Decision-Making (Jan 2025) + FDA–EMA Guiding Principles of Good AI Practice (Jan 2026)
frameworks.CDISC: FDA Data Standards Catalog / PMDA electronic study data (CDISC SDTM, ADaM, Define-XML, ODM)
